summary: John's 14th-great-grandfather; a fuller and cloth-maker of Long Melford, Suffolk, about 1517.
bio: Fuller (cloth-finisher) and cloth-maker of Long Melford; executor of John Hamond the elder of Melford (will dated 1517, proved 1528). A link further back to the Lawshall Hammonds is speculative. The Hammonds and Warrens were neighbours on Hall Street in Melford.
